fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of change set 01M6GCQA. The planner read internal/api/run.go: runRunResume refuses any unfinished run whose change set is in a terminal state (changeset.State.Terminal(): landed, rejected, withdrawn, superseded). A plan run lands its record during the interview, so a plan run that the gate stops on open questions (capability plan-run-stops-open) can never resume. The planner raised two questions (which intent to serve; how narrow the exemption is) and the arbiter answered with Decision plan-resume-landed-record-milestone-6: serve milestone-6; let through only plan-workflow runs whose change set is landed, keeping the refusal for rejected, withdrawn and superseded change sets and for every other workflow. One leaf was planned under plan-gate, beside plan-run-stops-open.
fields.title: Plan of the Fix: resume a plan run whose record landed (autonomous)
